options.name: proxy_protocol

options.name: anytls_idle_session_check_interval
options.title: Idle session check interval
options.description: Interval checking for idle sessions, in seconds.

options.name: anytls_idle_session_timeout
options.title: Idle session check timeout
options.description: In the check, close sessions that have been idle for longer than this, in seconds.

options.name: anytls_min_idle_session
options.title: Minimum idle sessions
options.description: In the check, at least the first n idle sessions are kept open.

options.name: hysteria_hop_interval
options.title: Hop interval
options.description: Port hopping interval in seconds.

options.name: hysteria_hop_interval_max
options.title: Max hop interval (1.14)
options.description: Maximum port hopping interval in seconds; the actual interval is randomized between the two values. Hysteria2 only.

options.name: hysteria_obfs_min_packet_size
options.title: Min obfs packet size (1.14)
options.description: Minimum on-wire packet size in bytes. Gecko only.

options.name: hysteria_obfs_max_packet_size
options.title: Max obfs packet size (1.14)
options.description: Maximum on-wire packet size in bytes. Gecko only.

options.name: hysteria_down_mbps
options.title: Max download speed
options.description: Max download speed in Mbps.

options.name: hysteria_up_mbps
options.title: Max upload speed
options.description: Max upload speed in Mbps.

options.name: hysteria_bbr_profile
options.title: BBR profile (1.14)
options.description: BBR congestion control algorithm profile. Hysteria2 only.

options.name: hysteria_disable_chrome_parrot
options.title: Disable Chrome QUIC fingerprint (1.14)
options.description: Disable Chrome QUIC handshake parroting, which is enabled by default since sing-box 1.14. Turn this on only when the server uses an Ed25519 certificate or the handshake otherwise fails.

options.name: ssh_client_version
options.title: Client version
options.description: Random version will be used if empty.

options.name: ssh_host_key
options.title: Host key
options.description: Accept any if empty.

options.name: tuic_congestion_control
options.title: Congestion control algorithm
options.description: QUIC congestion control algorithm.

options.name: tuic_udp_relay_mode
options.title: UDP relay mode
options.description: UDP packet relay mode.

options.name: tuic_udp_over_stream
options.title: UDP over stream
options.description: This is the TUIC port of the UDP over TCP protocol, designed to provide a QUIC stream based UDP relay mode that TUIC does not provide.

options.name: tuic_enable_zero_rtt
options.title: Enable 0-RTT handshake
options.description:
Enable 0-RTT QUIC connection handshake on the client side. This is not impacting much on the performance, as the protocol is fully multiplexed.
Disabling this is highly recommended, as it is vulnerable to replay attacks.

options.name: tuic_heartbeat
options.title: Heartbeat interval
options.description: Interval for sending heartbeat packets for keeping the connection alive (in seconds).

options.name: vmess_alterid
options.title: Alter ID
options.description: Legacy protocol support (VMess MD5 Authentication) is provided for compatibility purposes only, use of alterId > 1 is not recommended.

options.name: vmess_global_padding
options.title: Global padding
options.description: Protocol parameter. Will waste traffic randomly if enabled (enabled by default in v2ray and cannot be disabled).

options.name: vmess_authenticated_length
options.title: Authenticated length
options.description: Protocol parameter. Enable length block encryption.

options.name: transport
options.title: Transport
options.description: No TCP transport, plain HTTP is merged into the HTTP transport.

options.name: grpc_permit_without_stream
options.title: gRPC permit without stream
options.description: If enabled, the client transport sends keepalive pings even with no active connections.

options.name: http_idle_timeout
options.title: Idle timeout
options.description:
Specifies the period of time (in seconds) after which a health check will be performed using a ping frame if no frames have been received on the connection.
Please note that a ping response is considered a received frame, so if there is no other traffic on the connection, the health check will be executed every interval.

options.name: http_ping_timeout
options.title: Ping timeout
options.description:
Specifies the timeout duration (in seconds) after sending a PING frame, within which a response must be received.
If a response to the PING frame is not received within the specified timeout duration, the connection will be closed.

options.name: websocket_early_data
options.title: Early data
options.description: Allowed payload size is in the request.

options.name: wireguard_local_address
options.title: Local address
options.description: List of IP (v4 or v6) addresses prefixes to be assigned to the interface.

options.name: wireguard_private_key
options.title: Private key
options.description: WireGuard requires base64-encoded private keys.

options.name: wireguard_peer_public_key
options.title: Peer pubkic key
options.description: WireGuard peer public key.

options.name: wireguard_pre_shared_key
options.title: Pre-shared key
options.description: WireGuard pre-shared key.

options.name: wireguard_persistent_keepalive_interval
options.title: Persistent keepalive interval
options.description: In seconds. Disabled by default.

options.name: multiplex_brutal
options.title: Enable TCP Brutal
options.description: Enable TCP Brutal congestion control algorithm

options.name: multiplex_brutal_down
options.title: Download bandwidth
options.description: Download bandwidth in Mbps.

options.name: multiplex_brutal_up
options.title: Upload bandwidth
options.description: Upload bandwidth in Mbps.

options.name: multiplex_protocol
options.title: Protocol
options.description: Multiplex protocol.

options.name: multiplex_min_streams
options.title: Minimum streams
options.description: Minimum multiplexed streams in a connection before opening a new connection.

options.name: multiplex_max_streams
options.title: Maximum streams
options.description:
Maximum multiplexed streams in a connection before opening a new connection.
Conflict with Maximum connections and Minimum streams.

options.name: snell_version
options.title: Snell version
options.description: sing-box implements Snell v4/v5 wire as v4 and v6. The pre-shared key (Password above) must be 12-255 bytes for v6.

options.name: snell_userkey
options.title: User key
options.description: Optional; only required when connecting to a multi-user Snell server.

options.name: snell_reuse
options.title: Connection reuse
options.description: Enable connection reuse (the Snell v2 CONNECT command).

options.name: snell_obfs_mode
options.title: Obfuscation mode
options.description: HTTP obfuscation. v4 only.

options.name: snell_obfs_host
options.title: Obfuscation host
options.description: HTTP Host header sent when obfuscation mode is http. bing.com is used by default.

options.name: tls_sni
options.title: TLS SNI
options.description: Used to verify the hostname on the returned certificates unless insecure is given.

options.name: tls_alpn
options.title: TLS ALPN
options.description: List of supported application level protocols, in order of preference.

options.name: tls_insecure
options.title: Allow insecure
options.description:
Allow insecure connection at TLS client.
This is DANGEROUS, your traffic is almost like PLAIN TEXT! Use at your own risk!

options.name: tls_min_version
options.title: Minimum TLS version
options.description: The minimum TLS version that is acceptable.

options.name: tls_max_version
options.title: Maximum TLS version
options.description: The maximum TLS version that is acceptable.

options.name: tls_cipher_suites
options.title: Cipher suites
options.description: The elliptic curves that will be used in an ECDHE handshake, in preference order. If empty, the default will be used.

options.name: tls_handshake_timeout
options.title: Handshake timeout (1.14)
options.description: TLS handshake timeout in seconds. 15s is used by default.

options.name: tls_self_sign
options.title: Append self-signed certificate
options.description: If you have the root certificate, use this option instead of allowing insecure.

options.name: tls_cert_path
options.title: Certificate path
options.description: The path to the server certificate, in PEM format.

options.name: _upload_cert
options.title: Upload certificate
options.description: Save your configuration before uploading files!

options.name: tls_ech
options.title: Enable ECH
options.description: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello) is a TLS extension that allows a client to encrypt the first part of its ClientHello message.

options.name: tls_ech_config_path
options.title: ECH config path
options.description: The path to the ECH config, in PEM format. If empty, load from DNS will be attempted.

options.name: _upload_ech_config
options.title: Upload ECH config
options.description: Save your configuration before uploading files!

options.name: tls_utls
options.title: uTLS fingerprint
options.description: uTLS is a fork of "crypto/tls", which provides ClientHello fingerprinting resistance.

options.name: udp_fragment
options.title: UDP Fragment
options.description: Enable UDP fragmentation.

options.name: udp_over_tcp
options.title: UDP over TCP
options.description: Enable the SUoT protocol, requires server support. Conflict with multiplex.

options.name: auto_update
options.title: Auto update
options.description: Auto update subscriptions and geodata.

options.name: update_via_proxy
options.title: Update via proxy
options.description: Update subscriptions via proxy.

options.name: subscription_url
options.title: Subscription URL-s
options.description: Support Hysteria, Shadowsocks, Trojan, v2rayN (VMess), and XTLS (VLESS) online configuration delivery standard.

options.name: filter_nodes
options.title: Filter nodes
options.description: Drop/keep specific nodes from subscriptions.

options.name: filter_keywords
options.title: Filter keywords
options.description: Drop/keep nodes that contain the specific keywords. Regex is supported.

options.name: allow_insecure
options.title: Allow insecure
options.description:
Allow insecure connection by default when add nodes from subscriptions.
This is DANGEROUS, your traffic is almost like PLAIN TEXT! Use at your own risk!

options.name: _save_subscriptions
options.title: Save subscriptions settings
options.description: NOTE: Save current settings before updating subscriptions.
